**

Don Pepe in Tirol

** **

Welcome to Don Pepe in Tirol – your authentic Italian restaurant in the heart of Innsbruck!**

**

Since 2005, we’ve been serving up delicious Italian flavors in the charming atmosphere of the historic city center. Whether you’re craving fresh pasta, a juicy pizza, or a classic risotto, our menu has something for every taste. And don’t forget to try our famous **Tiramisu**—the perfect sweet finish to your meal!

** **

Our cozy, rustic setting makes every visit feel like a little escape to Italy, right here in the **Alpenland**. Come enjoy authentic Italian cuisine with a touch of **Tirol** hospitality!

** **

We look forward to welcoming you at **Don Pepe in Tirol**!

** **Visit us online | Find us in Innsbruck**
